title: docs: map P104 precision contracts and remaining implementation obligations
body:
The P104 entry point does not connect the retained precision results, so an old collector or whole-word handoff can look unresolved after a successor has already closed it. Add one source-pinned contract map and link it from the bottleneck brief.

The map distinguishes collector-entrance grids, atomic boundaries, whole-word native prefixes, the sharp retimed-word binding, conditional completed-error recovery, and the two-call rounded reference. It records the remaining recursive implementation/consumer obligations, the retained-output-grid restriction, the original-versus-retimed witness indices, and the unavailable-in-main original sharp-grid replay path.

Scope: documentation/consolidation side result, explicitly changed from the complex-mechanisms task draw after live overlap found the apparent precision tasks covered. Original main was `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455`; refreshed and rebased onto revision-6 main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`. Numerical inputs and the selected record are unchanged. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18977831).

Validation on Windows AMD64, CPython 3.14.6 (standard library):
- Five documented direct replay commands pass: internal collector; retimed internal grid; its separate integer oracle; retimed error/recovery; rounded native child. These include their built-in failure controls.
- The retimed oracle checks 30,007 scalar products; the rounded reference checks all 1,024 columns and 120 rounded fixtures, including 42 with nonzero errors.
- Read-only documentation preflight resolves 37 local links, checks four reviewed source heads against the retained dispositions and four literal word bindings, confirms selected-record bytes, and checks table structure.
- `git diff origin/main --check` passes. Final overlap refresh covers 234 open PRs and 1,702 Discussion records with complete reported pagination and no warnings; arbitrary diffs/unpublished work are outside coverage.

No new precision theorem, supplier, kappa or family expansion. Additional package suites, the original sharp-grid ZIP, native compiler, selected cold replay, Lean and hosted CI were not run.

Credit Nick Petalas, Ross Richardson, David/sandersdavid90-droid, Vasek/flyingviper, ywz65, commdata2338, Arham Tahir, Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales and the retained P104/native/precision lineage, with exact heads and detailed attribution in the map. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
